name: i18n readiness - MCP tool: evidence upload link (CREATE-ONLY)
description: CREATE-ONLY: OneDrive upload session for one NEW screenshot/evidence file under SHARED COMPANY FOLDER I18N/AI AUDITS/<product>/<run folder>/<subfolders>. Known products only, safe names, evidence file types. Rename on conflict, never overwrites.

assignments.name: how_to_upload
assignments.value: PUT the file bytes to upload_url with Content-Length and Content-Range: bytes 0-<size-1>/<size>. No Authorization header. Files over 60 MB: PUT in chunks (multiples of 320 KiB). On a name clash OneDrive renames the new file; the final name and webUrl are in the PUT response. Missing folders are created on the way.
